properties.name: tj.swagger.enable
properties.description: 是否开启 swagger(Knife4j) 文档功能，默认 false

properties.name: tj.swagger.enableResponseWrap
properties.description: 是否开启响应结果包装（R<T>）展示，默认 false

properties.name: tj.swagger.packagePath
properties.description: API接口扫描包

properties.name: tj.swagger.title
properties.description: API文档标题

properties.name: tj.swagger.description
properties.description: 文档描述

properties.name: tj.swagger.contactName
properties.description: 联系人姓名

properties.name: tj.swagger.contactUrl
properties.description: 联系人主页地址

properties.name: tj.swagger.contactEmail
properties.description: 联系人邮箱

properties.name: tj.swagger.version
properties.description: 版本

properties.name: powerjob.worker.enabled
properties.description: 是否启用 PowerJob Worker，默认 true

properties.name: powerjob.worker.app-name
properties.description: 应用名称，需在 PowerJob 控制台提前注册，用于分组隔离

properties.name: powerjob.worker.server-address
properties.description: PowerJob Server 地址，多个地址用逗号分隔，如 127.0.0.1:7700,127.0.0.1:7701

properties.name: powerjob.worker.port
properties.description: Worker 监听端口，默认 27777

properties.name: powerjob.worker.protocol
properties.description: 通讯协议，支持 http 和 akka，推荐 http

properties.name: powerjob.worker.store-strategy
properties.description: 本地存储策略，disk(磁盘) 或 memory(内存)

properties.name: powerjob.worker.max-result-length
properties.description: 任务返回结果最大长度，超过将被截断

properties.name: powerjob.worker.max-appended-wf-context-length
properties.description: 工作流上下文最大长度，超过将被丢弃

properties.name: powerjob.worker.max-lightweight-task-num
properties.description: 同时运行的轻量级任务数量上限

properties.name: powerjob.worker.max-heavyweight-task-num
properties.description: 同时运行的重量级任务数量上限

properties.name: powerjob.worker.allow-lazy-connect-server
properties.description: 是否允许延迟连接 PowerJob Server（Server 未就绪时也能启动 Worker）
